name: feedback
title: Feedback
description: Thumbs up or down that burst, then open a short form for a comment.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (data: { rating: FeedbackRating; text: string }) => Promise<void> | void
props.description: Called with the rating and the trimmed text when the form is sent. The form closes once the returned promise resolves.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading of the form. Default “Share feedback”.

props.name: upPrompt
props.description: The question above the field after a thumbs up.

props.name: downPrompt
props.description: The question above the field after a thumbs down.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text in the field. Default “Optional”.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: The text on the send button. Default “Send”.

props.name: sendingLabel
props.description: The text on the send button while it is sending.

props.name: thanksLabel
props.description: The line shown under the thumbs after sending.

props.name: upLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the thumbs up button. Default “Helpful”.

props.name: downLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the thumbs down button. Default “Not helpful”.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the close button. Default “Close”.

a11y.text: The thumbs are buttons. After a pick the comment form opens and the textarea takes focus. Escape closes the form and focus returns to the thumb that was pressed.

The thumbs are named by upLabel and downLabel and carry aria-pressed. The thanks line is a polite live region that stays mounted. The form is labelled by its heading, the close button is named by closeLabel, and the textarea has a label. The sparkles are aria-hidden.
The pop uses Motion with reduced motion set to user. Under reduced motion there is no pop and no wait: the form opens at once. The send button's press scale also stops.
